# Custom Telegram Bot Development

> Describe the Telegram bot you want and get a scoped quote. A short
> conversation with an assistant, a two-minute requirements form, and the brief
> goes straight to the team that builds it.

## What is built here

- Shop and e-commerce bots with in-chat payments
- Customer support bots, with or without AI replies
- Booking, reservation and appointment bots
- Notification, alert and scheduled-message bots
- Group and channel moderation tools
- Telegram Mini Apps and Web Apps
- Admin dashboards, databases and third-party API integrations

## How to get a quote

Open the site, describe the bot in your own words, and the form is filled in
from what you wrote. Sign-in with Telegram is optional. English and Persian.

## Notes

- No pricing is published; scope decides it, and a quote comes back per brief.
- Contact happens through the form on the site.
